item.requirement: Layer-aware diagnostics: establish which memory layer a query addresses (persistent/session/transient) before interpreting the answer; expectations are layer-conditional.
item.anchor: SPEC §3.4 Logging (I15 layer taxonomy), canonized v0.3 (owner signature 2026-10-27)

taxonomy: closed enum; extension by owner decision only
assignment: declared field on query/record; inference without source rejected

expectations.transient: exact answer is bonus, never evidence

unknown: honest 4th state; suspend judgment + loud diagnostic event (LOG-3.4)
